differential.name: Non‑ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
differential.rationale: Active diagnosis of acute NSTEMI, prior MI, and abnormal cardiac imaging strongly support ongoing ischemia.

differential.name: Type 1 cardiorenal syndrome (acute kidney injury secondary to acute cardiac dysfunction)
differential.rationale: Creatinine 2.8 mg/dL indicates new renal impairment in the setting of acute myocardial injury.

differential.name: Congestive hepatopathy (cardiac‑related liver congestion)
differential.rationale: Markedly elevated bilirubin (7.8 mg/dL) with normal transaminases and alkaline phosphatase suggests hepatic congestion from right‑sided heart failure.

differential.name: Acute decompensated heart failure
differential.rationale: History of MI, obesity, metabolic syndrome, and renal/hepatic derangements are typical precipitants of volume overload and ventricular dysfunction.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia and multiple chronic inflammatory/metabolic conditions explain low‑grade anemia contributing to fatigue and tissue hypoxia.
